items.title: The Mall Comeback Is Here
items.summary: Malls are outperforming every other property type as more investors conclude that enclosed shopping centers have more staying power than previously understood.  Mall values are up 13% over the past year, according to real-estate analytics firm Green Street.  As Kate King reports, mall owners are drawing crowds by renovating properties, adding luxury retailers and popular restaurants, and launching entertainment venues.
